desc: Baseline arcade vehicle speed, size, and handling model.

fields.name: display_name

handling.mode: handling model selector, arcade_v2 is current

steer.speed_band: low/mid/high speed anchors for steering kmh
steer.yaw_deg_s: low/mid/high max body yaw rate deg/s

tires.follow: normal travel direction follow rate per_s
tires.slide_follow: travel direction follow rate while sliding per_s
tires.slip_soft_deg: slip angle where slide starts to show deg
tires.slip_max_deg: slip angle used as full slide scale deg

slide.min_kmh: minimum speed for intentional slide kmh
slide.hold_kmh: minimum speed for keeping an already-started slide kmh
slide.full_kmh: speed where slide reaches full authority kmh
slide.decel_kmh_s: minimum speed drop while sliding km/h/s
slide.sustain_kmh: speed that full-throttle sliding tends to settle around km/h
slide.recover_kmh_s: speed recovery rate back to sustain while full-throttle sliding km/h/s

turn.drag: speed loss scalar while gripping and turning
turn.decel_kmh_s: minimum speed drop while gripping and turning km/h/s
turn.sustain_kmh: speed that full-throttle grip turning tends to settle around km/h
turn.recover_kmh_s: speed recovery rate back to sustain while full-throttle grip turning km/h/s

assist.counter_steer: slide reduction when steering against slip
assist.straighten: body straightening assist when no steering

fields.brake: simplified braking total; runtime uses brake.from and brake.total.t
